def components(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0]); unseen={(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if g[r][c]!=1}; cs=[]
    while unseen:
        seed=unseen.pop(); comp={seed}; stack=[seed]
        while stack:
            r,c=stack.pop()
            for p in ((r-1,c),(r+1,c),(r,c-1),(r,c+1)):
                if p in unseen:
                    unseen.remove(p);comp.add(p);stack.append(p)
        cs.append(comp)
    return cs

def transform(g):
    cs=components(g)
    assert len(cs)==2, len(cs)
    A,B=cs
    oa={p for p in A if g[p[0]][p[1]]==7}; ob={p for p in B if g[p[0]][p[1]]==7}
    candidates=[]
    # all translations placing an orange from either component on any cell of other
    ts={(r2-r1,c2-c1) for r1,c1 in oa for r2,c2 in B}|{(r1-r2,c1-c2) for r1,c1 in A for r2,c2 in ob}
    for dr,dc in ts:
        BM={(r+dr,c+dc) for r,c in B}; bom={(r+dr,c+dc) for r,c in ob}
        # overlaps involving orange and opposite shape
        score=len(oa&BM)+len(bom&A)
        if not score: continue
        U=A|BM
        rs=[p[0] for p in U];cs2=[p[1] for p in U]
        area=(max(rs)-min(rs)+1)*(max(cs2)-min(cs2)+1)
        orange_dist=min((abs(r-r2)+abs(c-c2) for r,c in oa for r2,c2 in bom),default=0)
        candidates.append((-score,area,orange_dist,dr,dc,U))
    *_,dr,dc,U=min(candidates)
    rs=[p[0] for p in U];cc=[p[1] for p in U]
    r0,r1=min(rs),max(rs);c0,c1=min(cc),max(cc)
    return [[4 if (r,c) in U else 1 for c in range(c0,c1+1)] for r in range(r0,r1+1)]

from pathlib import Path
import json
program = r'''def transform(grid):
    def components(g):
        H, W = len(g), len(g[0])
        unseen = {(r, c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if g[r][c] != 1}
        result = []
        while unseen:
            seed = unseen.pop()
            comp = {seed}
            stack = [seed]
            while stack:
                r, c = stack.pop()
                for dr in (-1, 0, 1):
                    for dc in (-1, 0, 1):
                        p = (r + dr, c + dc)
                        if p in unseen:
                            unseen.remove(p)
                            comp.add(p)
                            stack.append(p)
            result.append(comp)
        return result

    comps = components(grid)
    groups = [set(c) for c in comps if any(grid[r][k] == 4 for r, k in c)]
    for oc in (c for c in comps if all(grid[r][k] == 7 for r, k in c)):
        i = min(range(len(groups)), key=lambda j: min(
            abs(r-r2) + abs(c-c2) for r, c in oc for r2, c2 in groups[j]))
        groups[i] |= oc
    A, B = groups
    oa = {p for p in A if grid[p[0]][p[1]] == 7}
    ob = {p for p in B if grid[p[0]][p[1]] == 7}
    translations = ({(r2-r1, c2-c1) for r1, c1 in oa for r2, c2 in B} |
                    {(r1-r2, c1-c2) for r1, c1 in A for r2, c2 in ob})
    candidates = []
    for dr, dc in translations:
        bm = {(r+dr, c+dc) for r, c in B}
        bom = {(r+dr, c+dc) for r, c in ob}
        score = len(oa & bm) + len(bom & A)
        if not score:
            continue
        # Orange guide cells survive only where the two pieces overlap.
        union = (A-oa) | (bm-bom) | (oa & bm) | (bom & A)
        rs = [p[0] for p in union]
        cs = [p[1] for p in union]
        area = (max(rs)-min(rs)+1) * (max(cs)-min(cs)+1)
        distance = min(abs(r-r2)+abs(c-c2) for r, c in oa for r2, c2 in bom)
        # Multi-cell guides align exactly; single-cell guides use the compact fit.
        fit = (distance, area) if max(len(oa), len(ob)) > 1 else (area, distance)
        candidates.append((-score, *fit, dr, dc, union))
    union = min(candidates)[-1]
    rs = [p[0] for p in union]
    cs = [p[1] for p in union]
    return [[4 if (r, c) in union else 1 for c in range(min(cs), max(cs)+1)]
            for r in range(min(rs), max(rs)+1)]
'''
